summary: All 44 characters in bible/costumes.json have a ledger (costume_sheets.json): 52 costumes in total. Six new four-view costume sheets were generated, one call each (n=1, no retries, no provider errors). Alice's COS-002 reuses the age02 version base, which was already drawn in COS-002. Bill's COS-032 and the told-only Tortoise's COS-050 are skipped with reasons. Every other default costume maps to sheet.png.
genmedia: image -> volcengine model=doubao-seedream-5-0-pro-260628, 2560x1440, n=1; 6 billed images (14400 tokens each), 0 probes, 0 failures, 0 resubmissions

method.refs: --ref 1 = runs/p4-char-concept-cb1/work/character_sheet_template.jpg (pixel-identical JPEG of agents/06-art/character-concept/templates/character_sheet_template.png; true PNG refs trip TLS resets on this channel). --ref 2 = the character's final sheet.png as the identity anchor. No other refs: refs/characters/ and refs/props/costumes/ are empty.
method.prompt: SOUL layout sentence + photo-strip reinforcement + reference-role sentence (ref 2 gives identity only, not clothing) + gender word and stable identity traits from the base sheet's character block + 'Costume: ' + visual_en verbatim + 'Condition: ' + condition_and_wear + the pieces that change or are removed relative to the anchor, each named + 'Style: ' + style_fragment_ui verbatim. Full text is in each prompts.json costume_sheets[].
method.negative: negative_prompt_en verbatim, + negative_prompt_waking_addon_en for the sister (real human), + layout addon 'single full-bleed illustration, one single panel, scenery background, crowd, text labels'
method.user_refs: refs/style/alice.jpeg was read and applied the way style.json user_refs describes (through style_fragment_ui). It was not injected as --ref, because its full scene would pull scenery into a plain-backdrop sheet. Recorded in every prompts.json costume_sheets[].user_refs.
tools: code/gen_costume_sheets_p4-costume-sheet.py (assembles prompts and calls genmedia once per sheet)
